meta.title: Lorem Agency — Digital & Creative Studio
meta.description: Lorem Agency is a digital and creative studio building brands, websites and campaigns for ambitious teams, from the first workshop to launch day and beyond.

hero.title: We build brands
hero.summary: Strategy, design and code under one roof. We help ambitious teams launch brands, websites and campaigns that look sharp and work even harder.

clients.label: Trusted by teams who refuse to blend in

about.title: A small team with
about.description: Lorem Agency is an independent studio of strategists, designers and developers who care about the details most people never notice.
paragraphs: We keep our team small on purpose. You work directly with the people doing the work, with no account managers in between and no handoffs lost in translation.
From early-stage startups to global brands, we bring the same curiosity, honesty and craft to every brief.
about.imageAlt: Team members collaborating around a table covered in sketches and laptops

timeline.title: Founded in a spare room
timeline.description: Two designers, one laptop each and a first client who still works with us today.

timeline.title: Development joins design
timeline.description: We hired our first engineers and started shipping complete websites and apps.

timeline.title: Remote-first studio
timeline.description: The team went fully remote and grew across four time zones.

timeline.title: 100th launch
timeline.description: Our hundredth project went live, a rebrand and platform for a fintech scale-up.

timeline.title: Motion & campaigns
timeline.description: A dedicated motion team now brings our brands to life in video and social.

services.title: Everything you need
services.description: Pick one service or the full package. Either way, strategy, design and engineering stay connected from start to finish.

items.title: Brand Strategy
items.description: Research, positioning and messaging that give your brand a clear point of view and a reason to be chosen.

items.title: Visual Identity
items.description: Logos, typography, colour and guidelines built as a flexible system rather than a single static mark.

items.title: Web Design & Development
items.description: Fast, accessible websites and web apps, designed in detail and engineered to grow with your business.

items.title: Motion & Campaigns
items.description: Animated brand assets, launch films and social campaigns that make people stop scrolling.

process.title: Four steps,
process.description: A simple, transparent way of working keeps every project on time, on budget and true to the original idea.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: We learn your business, audience and goals through workshops and research.

steps.title: Define
steps.description: Strategy, scope and a clear roadmap, agreed before any pixels are pushed.

steps.title: Design & Build
steps.description: Short sprints with weekly demos, so you see progress and steer as we go.

steps.title: Launch & Grow
steps.description: We launch, measure and keep improving with you after go-live.
